title: [Reiki] Lilypads
description: This mod adds lily pad plantlets and makes it so lily pads & lily pad plantlets by extension have a biome tint like some of Minecraft's foliage!
body:
This mod adds Lily Pad Plantlets, a block similar to Leaf Litter that can be placed multiple times except on water!! 

As a bonus feature, this mod implements biome tint for this new foliage as well as the regular Lily Pad!

Also, yes, this is based off the small lily pads seen at Minecraft: Experience.

_Note: This is my very first mod, so here be dragons, everything works to a stable enough degree, but there are a few minor quirks you may notice within the mod. I plan on trying to fix these, but no promises, since programming is funny. The mod otherwise runs perfectly fine and shouldn't crash your game._

Q&A:
Do you plan to port to other mod loaders? 
Maybe one day, but I'd have to learn how to do that and stuff.

Do you plan to port to other versions?
I plan to, but since modding modern versions is complicated, it may take a while or just not happen.

Will there be compatibility added for certain mods?
If I am able to learn how to, yes, but again don't expect this soon.

Can I use this in Mod Packs?
Yeah!! Just again be aware that in the mods current state there could be some small hiccups.

What is "Reiki"?
Reiki is  the name of the series of mods / bigger mod I plan to make. That's the dream at  least..
